title: September 2026: A more personalized homepage, activity join codes, and custom moderation
summary: Flint's September 2026 updates let teachers share activities with join codes, get AI feedback on file uploads, set custom moderation rules, and more.
body_markdown: Teachers who assign file-upload activities such as essays, lab reports, and handwritten work, used to only see that a student submitted something. Now Sparky reads the full document and provides the same detailed feedback teachers already rely on in chat sessions: strengths, areas for improvement, follow-up suggestions, and rubric scores.
